evidence.quote: In my remarks today, I will discuss the importance of using an evidence-based approach to bank regulatory policy, which has been a long-standing theme and goal of this conference.
Bank failures demand scrutiny, but bank failures alone do not justify wholesale revisions to the bank regulatory framework.
The research sends a strong signal that preserving local relationship-based community banks is vital to local economies.
